title: Two More Stop Conditions: Idempotency and Malformed Decision
description: Two misbehaving stand-in supervisors trigger the remaining stop conditions: stubborn repeats the same extractor call (idempotency check fires), and chatty replies in prose instead of JSON (malformed decision fires).

steps.description: The stubborn supervisor always returns a call action for extractor with the same input, causing the same (agent, text) pair to be seen twice.
Lines 2-3: stubborn ignores the transcript and always asks for extraction, which triggers the idempotency guard on turn 2.
The chatty supervisor returns a plain English sentence instead of the required JSON format, triggering the JSONDecodeError catch.
Lines 5-6: chatty replies with prose, so json.loads fails and the loop stops immediately with 'malformed decision'.

steps.question: Which stop condition fires first for stubborn, and on which turn?

steps.description: The loop iterates over both supervisors, clears CALLS each time, runs supervise, and prints the status, turns, and model calls.

stubborn runs: turn 1 extracts, turn 2 repeats extractor -> stopped: repeated call to extractor (2 turns, 3 model calls). chatty runs: turn 1 returns prose -> stopped: malformed decision (1 turn, 1 model call).
